propositions: Agentic runs waste 40-70% of request budget by repeatedly executing identical tool calls (144x search_files, 62x looped on deterministic '(no matches)') without memoization or early steering.

Duplicate allowlisted read-only tool calls (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) must be memoized at the shared agent-call seam and return cached results without re-executing, while error results (Error:-prefixed strings) must re-execute on retry.

Memoized duplicate calls must trigger escalating static nudge text (level-1 on first repeat, level-2 thereafter) to steer the model away from the loop, with nudge content byte-stable for provider prompt caching.

The existing runaway guard must remain the abort backstop and continue observing every duplicate signature in its windowed distinct-ratio calculation, even after memoization reduces real tool executions.

Error results and non-allowlisted tools (e.g., record_criterion_verdict, write operations) must bypass memoization entirely, while deterministic sentinel-empty results ("(no matches)", "(empty)", "(empty range)") must be memoized as honest stable answers.

Wrapper nesting order must be enforced (guard outermost → memo → steering) to ensure the guard observes memoized duplicates and the memo short-circuits before steering logic, with live Bedrock capture proving nudge-broken loops and actuator escalation in production.
